projects.title: Pathwise
projects.synopsis: A learning platform inspired by Brilliant, with courses broken into short interactive lessons. It includes practice questions, feedback, saved progress, daily streaks, and a leaderboard.

projects.title: Monkey Sense
projects.synopsis: A practice site for Texas UIL Number Sense, with timed mental math tests, configurable practice modes, scoring, and performance stats.

projects.title: Anki
projects.synopsis: My fork of Anki, the spaced repetition flashcard app. The desktop app uses Rust and TypeScript to manage flashcard collections and schedule reviews.

projects.title: HastOS
projects.synopsis: A site for learning systems programming through coursework and coding exercises. It includes a browser IDE, automated grading, interview practice, and an AI tutor called SLAVA.

projects.title: TraceTick
projects.synopsis: A local tool that turns Cursor conversation transcripts into training data for a small model. It uses LoRA fine-tuning to learn coding conventions and response styles from past conversations.

projects.title: Dungeon Core
projects.synopsis: A dungeon-building strategy game about designing rooms, placing traps, and defending against waves of heroes. It includes solo runs, a head-to-head mode, achievements, and cloud saves.

projects.title: CoolHastorGames
projects.synopsis: A browser game collection with arcade, puzzle, and party games, including multiplayer options. The site has search, featured games, and player profiles.

projects.title: Stacker Wars
projects.synopsis: A fantasy strategy game built around towers and merging armies. It includes a story campaign, skirmishes against the AI, multiplayer matches, and a lore codex.

projects.title: Debate Lab
projects.synopsis: A debate practice app with source packets, timed rounds, AI opponents, and feedback tied to the round transcript. It supports voice input and spoken opponent responses.

projects.title: EduLLM
projects.synopsis: A research project that fine-tunes small language models to predict how students distribute their answers across multiple-choice options. It includes data preparation, baseline comparisons, training scripts, and evaluation tools.

projects.title: Crux
projects.synopsis: Exam-readiness tools built on Anki and AnkiDroid, with a Rust engine for identifying weak areas and practice drills for the GRE Mathematics Subject Test. The project keeps the original Anki and AnkiDroid credits and licenses.

projects.title: MIT Readiness Atlas
projects.synopsis: A local desktop app for exploring fictional student profiles and comparing activities against source-linked rubrics. It focuses on evidence and similarity between profiles rather than predicting admission outcomes.

projects.title: MIT Readiness Research Pipeline
projects.synopsis: Scripts for collecting, cleaning, and checking public-source research records. The public repository contains the pipeline code; person-level datasets and raw page captures are excluded.

projects.title: TETR.IO Bot
projects.synopsis: A Tetris bot with board evaluation, move search, offline simulations, and benchmarking tools. It includes a TETR.IO controller designed for approved bot accounts in private rooms.

projects.title: Tetherfall
projects.synopsis: A Unity RPG prototype with exploration, combat, recruitable companions, and settlement building. The source includes the game assets, package configuration, and project settings.

projects.title: StudyBuddy
projects.synopsis: An AI tutoring app built with Llama 3.3 and Cloudflare Workers AI. It explains topics, generates quizzes, and keeps track of study progress across sessions.
